stock.description: Xikang Cloud Hospital Holdings Inc. specializes in constructing customized digital healthcare platforms designed for urban settings. Its business operations are structured into four main categories: Cloud Hospital Platform Services, Internet Medical Services, Health Management Services, and Smart Healthcare Products. The Cloud Hospital Platform Services unit provides advanced technological solutions to local governmental bodies, medical institutions, and insurance providers. Through its Internet Medical Services, the company offers a range of options including virtual hospital consultations, remote medical support, intelligent family physician initiatives, and online home care assistance. The Health Management Services division delivers comprehensive wellness oversight and specific chronic condition management programs. Lastly, the Smart Healthcare Products segment markets innovative health-related devices to a broad customer base, encompassing municipal authorities, primary care facilities, businesses, and individual consumers. The company was founded on May 12, 2011, and its headquarters are situated in Shanghai, China.
